description: This file contains data access layer classes and functions for managing notes, tags, and note-tag relationships in a Postgres database. It includes CRUD operations, query handling, and internal helpers for converting database rows to Python dictionaries.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Manages CRUD operations and queries for notes.

classes.name: TagsRepository
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations and querying for tags.

classes.name: NoteTagsRepository
classes.description: Manages associations between notes and tags.

methods.description: Retrieves tags associated with a specific note.

methods.description: Converts a database row into a note dictionary, including tags.

methods.description: Updates an existing note's title and/or content.
